summary: Implement SP-02 branch-scoped Purchase Order operations, direct purchase orchestration, operational supplier fulfillment evidence, retry-safe receipt/correction workflows, API composition, persistence, and Arabic-first web surfaces without duplicating Procurement or Billing truth.
protectedReason: SP-02 implements the architecture-approved procurement-fulfillment owner, extends the canonical Procurement Finance PO owner with authoritative branch/commercial and exact receipt-outcome evidence, adds a minimal Platform Core idempotent-audit public capability required for retry-safe operational auditing, wires API/web composition, and adds one forward migration. It does not create a second PO, supplier-invoice, payment, or accounting truth.
